name: dsh-loci
title: Loci memory palace
description: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness where the prompt holds only a stable index: full text is one lookup away, facts are bi-temporal, and only verified entries are injected.
descriptionZh: 给 DSH 的长期记忆：提示词里只放稳定索引，全文按需取回；事实双时间可查，只有已核实的条目才会被注入。
highlights: 0 bytes injected on an empty store; a hard 3,584-byte budget afterwards
the index never reorders on write, so the prompt prefix survives
loci_search returns total + cursor: a broad question can list everything
CJK bigram retrieval — 路径断言 and 迁移 both match
bi-temporal history: edits close a revision instead of deleting it
only verified facts are injected; instruction-shaped text is quarantined
no model call, no network, no native module in the default path
limits: deterministic capture records only explicit durable statements
vector search is brute-force cosine and off by default
memory is plaintext at rest; rely on disk encryption
